market_summary: Nifty rebounded 1.14% to 25,514 (about a nine-month closing high) and Sensex 1.21% to 83,022 on Thu 19 Nov after a gap-down start; autos jumped 4.4% (Maruti +7.3%, M&M and Eicher +4.6%) and consumer durables 3.6% as copper and aluminium fell, while IT lost 1.1% after Fed minutes pointed to more US rate hikes. Foreign investors bought ₹7,411 cr (over ₹1 lakh cr so far in November) and domestic funds sold ₹1,357 cr; India VIX rose 2.1% to 15.90. Results season is essentially over (only small caps report today), so moves now come from broker notes, commodities and the RBI policy on 4 Dec.

buy_ideas.name: Eicher Motors
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 20% and profit about 15%. Stock closed ₹8,056 (+4.6%) on 19 Nov as autos rallied 4.4% on cheaper copper and aluminium, which eases the margin worry. Emkay's ₹9,100 target is about 13% above the close.
buy_ideas.risks: EBITDA margin fell 80 bps to 23.7%, and the stock has already jumped in one day; Motilal Oswal is only Neutral at ₹7,420. Metal prices can bounce back.

buy_ideas.name: Laurus Labs
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up about 33% to ₹2,206 cr, led by CDMO up about 86%; EBITDA ₹750 cr at a 34% margin (up 962 bps) and profit ₹437 cr. Still the cleanest earnings beat on the list; pharma rose 0.6% on 19 Nov.
buy_ideas.risks: Upside to target only about 9%. CDMO orders are lumpy. No fresh price found today; ₹2,338 is the broker's reference price, so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: Hitachi Energy India
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 64% and profit up 21%; new orders up 86%, taking the order book to ₹33,300 cr. IDBI sees revenue up 57% in FY27 and margins rising to 16.7% by FY28; target about 25% above the reference price.
buy_ideas.risks: Price is implied from the 17 Nov note (no fresh quote found), so check it. Very expensive stock, and profit grew much slower than revenue.

buy_ideas.name: ABB India
buy_ideas.thesis: September-quarter revenue up 12% and profit up 8%, with a record order book up 36% to about ₹12,900 cr. Two brokers say Buy, targets about 18-20% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: Margin fell 70 bps and profit growth was modest; valued at about 60 times 2028 earnings. No fresh price found today; ₹6,923 is from the earlier broker notes.

portfolio_notes.EICHERMOT: Moved into buy ideas: up 4.6% to ₹8,056 on 19 Nov with the auto rally. Emkay ₹9,100 Buy still stands.
portfolio_notes.SBIN: PSU banks rose 2.3% on 19 Nov and Bank Nifty closed above 63,000 for the first time. CLSA's ₹1,325 target still stands.
portfolio_notes.APOLLOHOSP: Fell 1.0% to ₹8,730 on 19 Nov, among the top Nifty losers. Motilal's ₹10,400 target still stands; no new news.
portfolio_notes.ITC: Plans staggered cigarette price hikes in 2027. Anand Rathi's ₹325 Buy stands, but Q2 profit fell 18%, so it is not an earnings buy.
portfolio_notes.KALYANKJIL: Q2 was strong (revenue +31%, profit +64%, about ₹73 cr of that a one-off land gain); UBS ₹950 and Jefferies ₹900 say Buy. Consumer durables rose 3.6% on 19 Nov, but it is still tied to gold prices; small positions only.

portfolio_notes.NATCOPHARM: No fresh news; ICICI Direct's ₹1,000 Buy still stands. Profit is still well below last year, so only small positions.

portfolio_notes.WEWORK: No fresh news or price today; ICICI Securities' ₹933 target still stands.
portfolio_notes.DEEPAKFERT: No fresh news today; the analyst average of about ₹1,845 still stands.

portfolio_notes.FIRSTCRY: Taken off the avoid list only because there is no fresh news; JM Financial's ₹245 target still stands.
